pages.text:
看后面要说哪种能力
good at + 技能或活动
good with + 人或事物
good with tools 也成立。
也能说 good at working with children。

pages.text:
答案与判断点
1. He is good at fixing bikes.
fixing bikes 是做的活动。
2. She is good with animals.
animals 是应对的对象。
with 也能接工具、钱等事物。
